abstract: Maintains backup generation records, substation connections, and renewable solar credits
system_message:
You are the Utility grid interface engineer (UGIE). Your primary responsibilities include maintaining backup generation records, monitoring substation connections, and logging renewable solar credits across prospective event venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains backup generation records, substation connections, and renewable solar credits（GRIDPOW）
information_points.content:
UGIE-GRIDPOW-TXW：For Northbank Maritime Expo Centre, on-site emergency power backup is reported as not present across critical plenary hall systems and life-safety circuits in the facility electrical commissioning review, and direct solar generation credit is measured at 100 GJ under the certified grid feed-in ledger evaluated for the summit calendar month aggregation window.
UGIE-GRIDPOW-22Z：For Northbank Maritime Expo Centre, on-site emergency power backup is verified as active across critical plenary hall systems and life-safety circuits based on the facility electrical commissioning review, and direct solar generation credit is 40 GJ according to the certified grid feed-in ledger for the summit calendar week aggregation window.
UGIE-GRIDPOW-E93：For Riverside Aerodrome Pavilion, on-site emergency power backup is confirmed present across critical plenary hall systems and life-safety circuits via the facility electrical commissioning review, and direct solar generation credit stands at 100 GJ in the certified grid feed-in ledger for the summit calendar week aggregation window.
UGIE-GRIDPOW-2YB：For Highland Valley Convention Hub, on-site emergency power backup is not available for critical plenary hall systems and life-safety circuits per the facility electrical commissioning review, while direct solar generation credit reached 80 GJ under the certified grid feed-in ledger evaluated across the summit calendar week aggregation window.

information_points.title: Substation thermal headroom（PEAKLOAD）
information_points.content:
UGIE-PEAKLOAD-GKL：Substation telemetry logs for Northbank Maritime Expo Centre record a thermal buffer margin of 25 MVA on the feeder transformer connection serving the venue.
UGIE-PEAKLOAD-L2G：Substation telemetry logs for Highland Valley Convention Hub indicate a thermal buffer margin of 35 MVA remaining on the feeder transformer connection serving the venue.
UGIE-PEAKLOAD-7WT：Substation telemetry logs for Riverside Aerodrome Pavilion document a thermal buffer margin of 15 MVA on the feeder transformer connection serving the venue.
